name: 29203 · Columbia, SC
findings: ZIP 29203 (Columbia) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29203 (Columbia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29203 (Columbia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
